DEF-002.rootCause: Health endpoint used stale hardcoded fallback metadata while portable manifest and VERSION.txt were generated from packaging metadata.
DEF-002.solution: Health reads ANCLORA_FILESTUDIO_VERSION; Windows launcher reads manifest.json and exports ANCLORA_FILESTUDIO_VERSION and ANCLORA_FILESTUDIO_BUILD_ID.
DEF-002.result: manifest, VERSION.txt and runtime health inputs are coherent

DEF-003.rootCause: Image attributes were static stubs with width and height set to 0.
DEF-003.solution: file-detector dynamically loads Sharp server-side and populates real image metadata.
DEF-003.result: descriptor returns real image dimensions and reliable metadata

DEF-004.rootCause: QPDF read operation from options only, so rotate jobs without options.operation defaulted to linearize and completed without rotation.
DEF-004.solution: QPDF normalizes operation from plan.operation, applies explicit page range rotation, and validates resulting rotation metadata.
DEF-004.result: rotated PDFs show changed page rotation and validation checks the change

DEF-005.rootCause: Next standalone source maps, trace metadata and server config carried absolute build paths.
DEF-005.solution: Packaging removes build-only metadata, sanitizes server.js metadata, and verify/smoke fail on developer workspace paths.
DEF-005.result: no developer workspace paths found in staging or verified portable text files

DEF-006.rootCause: Output filename builder appended target extension to the full input title.
DEF-006.solution: Centralized output filename helper removes only the final input extension before appending target format.
DEF-006.result: converted output filenames no longer get double extensions
